title: Smoky Lamb Kebabs
description: Juicy lamb skewers marinated in smoky flavors and grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of zesty tzatziki sauce.

ingredients.name: Zesty Greek yogurt marinade
ingredients.notes: Mix with 2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp oregano

ingredients.name: Smoky paprika
ingredients.notes: Add to marinade for extra flavor

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Season lamb cubes before threading onto skewers

ingredients.name: Mediterranean salad (optional)
ingredients.notes: Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper

ingredients.name: Tzatziki sauce (optional)
ingredients.notes: Mix with cucumber, garlic, dill, yogurt, lemon juice, and olive oil

instructions: Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with zesty yogurt marinade and sprinkle with smoky paprika.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches medium-rare (130°F/54°C).
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of Mediterranean salad or tzatziki sauce, if desired.
